text:
Zoe (Product): Quick alignment thread  GTM asked for a chargeback-ready view in Console. Core asks: per-route chargeback CSVs, route->trace audit links, error fingerprints with simple RCA tags, and a shareable finance dashboard template. We're limited to ~2 engineers this quarter. Can we agree a minimal pilot that looks polished to customers?

Marco (Eng-Infra): From infra POV the fast path is aggregated exports + an index for sampled traces. Exact per-request accounting touches billing/runtime and is a GA item. Rough: 2 sprints for Pilot, 4+ for GA.

Lina (ML Ops): We can emit est_cost + confidence_pct using token-profile estimator. In spikes we saw ~90% correlation. Proposal: expose est_cost and a simple confidence_band in CSV. Also tag model_version so we can detect drift.

Anika (Customer Success): Customers will accept "ESTIMATED" for hosted preview if migration path to audited Dedicated numbers is explicit. Need export shaped like invoice rows: [route, start, end, tokens_est, cost_est, confidence_pct, note].

Zoe (Product): Proposed split: Pilot (hosted) = aggregated CSVs (ESTIMATED) + trace linking (sampled) + fingerprint table (top 20) + finance dashboard template. GA (dedicated/private) = audited per-invocation attribution, reconciliation job, exportable audited CSV. Agree?

Marco (Eng-Infra): Agree. Implementation notes:
- CSV export: route/time-window aggregates, include model_version & batching_mode, note=ESTIMATED.
- Trace linking: maintain route -> recent_sampled_trace_ids index. Sampling policy needs product guidance.

Lina (ML Ops): Sampling recs: increase sample rate for errors and for high-est_cost outliers. Pseudocode:
```
if is_error or est_cost > p95: sample_rate=0.1 else sample_rate=0.01
```
This keeps storage bounded and surfaces audit cases.

Anika (Customer Success): I'll recruit 2 pilot customers willing to be labeled Preview/Estimated. Also will draft a migration playbook describing how to move to Dedicated auditing.

Zoe (Product): Acceptance criteria for Pilot:
- UI: \"Finance\" page with route selector, time range, export CSV button, and a saved finance dashboard template.
- CSV: columns [route, start_ts, end_ts, tokens_est, cost_est, confidence_pct, note=ESTIMATED].
- Trace linking: clicking a route shows sampled traces (min 3 where available).
- Fingerprint view: top 20 fingerprints with sample_trace_id and an RCA tag.
- Docs: clear \"Estimated hosted numbers\" language + migration playbook.

Marco (Eng-Infra): Risks: estimator drift after runtime changes (quantization, batching). We'll emit model_version and add a nightly recalibration job for confidence. Also ensure exports scrub PII.

Lina (ML Ops): For GA audited flow we'll need: 1) runtime to emit final token delta, 2) atomic attach of cost+trace_id to billing row, 3) nightly reconcile. Ballpark 4 sprints cross-team.

doc-bot: Created ticket FIN-CHG-77: "chargeback pilot: estimated CSVs + trace linking + fingerprints" assigned to eng-infra, ml-ops. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-CHG-77

Zoe (Product): Next steps: Marco/Lina run 3-day spikes (estimator accuracy + sampling config) and produce sample CSVs by Wed EOD. Anika to confirm pilots and draft customer messaging. We'll review in Friday PM sync. :thumbsup:
